slots.caption: Figure 1.1 — The author, qualifying himself.
slots.alt: A man kneels in debris patting the floor with both hands while catastrophe unfolds unnoticed in the window behind him.
slots.prompt: A cartoonish bean-bodied older man in a flat cap and long tarp coat, on his hands and knees on a debris-strewn floor, patting the boards with both oversized hands, head down, entirely absorbed. Behind him a simple rectangular window frame shows an orange-tinted skyline of tilted buildings and smoke columns, drawn small and flat. He is not looking at it. Minimal props: an overturned chair, scattered angular glass shards. Orange used only for the window beyond the glass.

slots.caption: Figure 1.3 — The whole method, as originally issued.
slots.alt: A tiny three-box flowchart of the three questions, drawn in pen on the back of a creased envelope.
slots.prompt: A creased, slightly torn paper envelope lying flat, drawn in flat black line art, with a hand-drawn three-box flowchart scrawled on its back in the same ink. Three plain rectangles connected by downward arrows, each containing a simple glyph instead of words — a drop for bleeding, a pair of lungs for air, a small stick figure with a question mark over it. One orange thumbprint smudge at the envelope's corner. Loose, hasty, marginal. No background scenery.

slots.caption: Figure 1.2 — The order to think in: three minutes of air, three hours of shelter, three days of water, three weeks of food. The numbers are a mnemonic, not a timetable.
slots.alt: A four-tread staircase diagram, the treads numbered one to four for air, shelter, water and food.
slots.prompt: A clean four-tread staircase diagram seen in flat side profile, drawn as a civil-defence pamphlet figure. The treads descend left to right and are labelled in order with orange callout numerals 1 to 4 in orange circles: tread 1 air, tread 2 shelter, tread 3 water, tread 4 food. Each tread carries a tiny flat glyph above it — a pair of lungs, a simple lean-to roof, a water drop, a tin can. Generous empty cream space around the staircase, single subject, no background scenery, no text beyond the callout numerals.
